meaning:
Ἀμιναδάβ, ὁ indecl. (Heb עַמִּינָדָב),
Amminadab: Mat.1:4, Luk.3:33 (WH om.).†
(AS)

renderings.kjv: Which was the son of Aminadab

elsewhere.note: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.
the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,
